items.label: Chic Arch Design
items.value: This elegant bookshelf features graceful arched detailing and clean wooden frames, adding sophisticated charm to any room. Its versatile style blends seamlessly with modern and traditional decor alike

items.label: Large Storage Capacity
items.value: Features five spacious shelves, a storage drawer, and a filing cabinet drawer to accommodate books, decorative items, small items, and legal-size documents. Keep everything visible yet neatly organized

items.label: Versatile Bookcase
items.value: More than just for books—display collectibles, organize files, or store essentials. Perfect as a living room showcase, home office vertical file cabinet, or bedroom storage solution

items.label: Sturdy Construction
items.value: Constructed with premium E1 particleboard and a heightened stabilizing base, this bookshelf with drawers offers reliable strength. The included anti-tip kit ensures added safety

items.label: Simple Assembly
items.value: Clear instructions and numbered parts make assembling the 5-tier arched bookshelf a breeze. Our friendly support team is available 24/7 if you need assistance

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bedroom, Living Room, Office, Study Room

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe with Damp Cloth, Wipe with Dry Cloth
